$$

$$

$$
x=e^{t},\,y=\sqrt{t}.
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t)) & =(3 x y^{2})\,i+(2 y)\,j \\  & =(3 (e^{t}) (\sqrt{t})^{2})\,i+(2 (\sqrt{t}))\,j \\  & =(3 t e^{t})\,i+(2 \sqrt{t})\,j.\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}r^{\prime}(t) & =\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t}\,i+\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t}\,j \\  & =\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}(e^{t})i+\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}(\sqrt{t})j \\  & =(e^{t})\,i+(\frac{1}{2 \sqrt{t}})\,j.\end{aligned}

$$

$$

Use the supplied parameterization and limits to compute $F(r(t))\cdot r'(t)$. Do not evaluate the integral or change variables.
question.:question/worked-solution:
We will use the formula

$$
\int_C F\cdot\mathrm{d}r=\int_a^b F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t)\,\mathrm{d}t.
$$

Along the curve $C,$ we have 

$$
x=t \cos{\left(t \right)},\,y=t \sin{\left(t \right)}.
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t)) & =(- 4 x - 2 y)\,i+(2 x - y)\,j \\  & =(- 4 (t \cos{\left(t \right)}) - 2 (t \sin{\left(t \right)}))\,i+(2 (t \cos{\left(t \right)}) - (t \sin{\left(t \right)}))\,j.\end{aligned}
$$

Computing $r'(t),$ we get 

$$
\begin{aligned}r^{\prime}(t) & =\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t}\,i+\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t}\,j \\  & =\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}(t \cos{\left(t \right)})i+\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}(t \sin{\left(t \right)})j \\  & =(- t \sin{\left(t \right)} + \cos{\left(t \right)})\,i+(t \cos{\left(t \right)} + \sin{\left(t \right)})\,j.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t) & =((- 2 t \sin{\left(t \right)} - 4 t \cos{\left(t \right)})\,i+(- t \sin{\left(t \right)} + 2 t \cos{\left(t \right)})\,j)\cdot ((- t \sin{\left(t \right)} + \cos{\left(t \right)})\,i+(t \cos{\left(t \right)} + \sin{\left(t \right)})\,j) \\  & =(- 2 t \sin{\left(t \right)} - 4 t \cos{\left(t \right)})\cdot (- t \sin{\left(t \right)} + \cos{\left(t \right)})+(- t \sin{\left(t \right)} + 2 t \cos{\left(t \right)})\cdot (t \cos{\left(t \right)} + \sin{\left(t \right)}) \\  & =(- 4 t \cos{\left(t \right)})\cdot (- t \sin{\left(t \right)} + \cos{\left(t \right)})+(- 2 t \sin{\left(t \right)})\cdot (- t \sin{\left(t \right)} + \cos{\left(t \right)})+(2 t \cos{\left(t \right)})\cdot (t \cos{\left(t \right)} + \sin{\left(t \right)})+(- t \sin{\left(t \right)})\cdot (t \cos{\left(t \right)} + \sin{\left(t \right)}) \\  & =2 t^{2} \sin^{2}{\left(t \right)} + 3 t^{2} \sin{\left(t \right)} \cos{\left(t \right)} + 2 t^{2} \cos^{2}{\left(t \right)} - t \sin^{2}{\left(t \right)} - 4 t \cos^{2}{\left(t \right)} \\  & =t^{2} \left(2 \sin^{2}{\left(t \right)} + 3 \sin{\left(t \right)} \cos{\left(t \right)} + 2 \cos^{2}{\left(t \right)}\right) + t \left(- \sin^{2}{\left(t \right)} - 4 \cos^{2}{\left(t \right)}\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we can write the integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int_C F(r)\cdot\mathrm{d}r & =\int_{0}^{\frac{4 \pi}{3}}F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t)\,\mathrm{d}t \\  & =\int_{0}^{\frac{4 \pi}{3}}(t^{2} \left(2 \sin^{2}{\left(t \right)} + 3 \sin{\left(t \right)} \cos{\left(t \right)} + 2 \cos^{2}{\left(t \right)}\right) + t \left(- \sin^{2}{\left(t \right)} - 4 \cos^{2}{\left(t \right)}\right))\,dt.\end{aligned}
$$
